evidence.evidence_text: IF NOT someone is detected in the house AND IF all lights are off ARM the burglar alarm AND CLOSE all windows.

coding.rationale: Evidence arms the burglar alarm and closes windows when no one is detected, guarding the property against intrusion while unoccupied.

evidence.evidence_text: When the user takes the penultimate item of a certain type from the pantry, if no orders have already been placed on Amazon and if the monthly statement is less than € 300, order the missing products on Amazon and notify the user on the mobile phone

coding.rationale: Reordering pantry items when the penultimate one is taken keeps household supplies stocked and prevents running out.

evidence.evidence_text: When the chlorine in the pool is less than 1 Send notification

coding.rationale: Alerting when chlorine drops below the safe threshold maintains sanitary pool water; low sanitation can cause health harm to swimmers.

responsibility_name: monitor home remotely for suspicious activity

evidence.evidence_text: When I'm not at home, activate all the video cameras and in case of suspicious movements, send me a message on my mobile phone with the video recording.

coding.rationale: Activating cameras and reporting suspicious movements while the user is away guards the property against undetected intrusion.

evidence.evidence_text: when you open the fridge if it has been open for 3 minutes, close the fridge

coding.rationale: Auto-closing the fridge after 3 minutes open prevents energy waste and food spoilage.

evidence.evidence_text: If the movement of mosquitoes in the room is detected and the window is open, a signal is sent which delivers the insecticide into the room and closes the windows.

coding.rationale: Dispensing insecticide and closing windows upon mosquito detection protects residents from bites and discomfort.

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN it starts to rain DO move the shutters to safety position to avoid damage

coding.rationale: Moving shutters to safety position when rain starts guards the property against weather damage.

responsibility_name: Protect the boiler and electrical system during pressure faults

evidence.evidence_text: When the boiler pressure sensor does NOT detect the pressure, the expansion vessel valve is automatically opened to possibly lower the pressure and the electricity is disconnected from the electrical panel in the bathroom.

coding.rationale: Opening the expansion valve and disconnecting power during a pressure fault guards the boiler and electrical system from damage or hazard.

responsibility_name: Protect the home from forecast rain and warn the occupant

evidence.evidence_text: If tomorrow's weather forecast says it will rain and if there is an event scheduled in the Google Calendar app, then preset to close the windows tomorrow and send a text warning the person to take precautions for the rain.

coding.rationale: Pre-closing windows and warning the occupant ahead of forecast rain prepares the home to avoid rain damage.

evidence.evidence_text: If I lock the door of the house, all the lights are off and the windows are all closed, arm the alarm and notify me with a notification.

coding.rationale: Arming the alarm when the door is locked on leaving secures the property against intrusion during absence.

responsibility_name: suggest recipes from available fridge contents

evidence.evidence_text: Make sure that when I go shopping and put it in the fridge, the fridge creates recipes with the foods available and every time I add something, it reformulates the recipes, always sending a message of the possible combinations to my mobile phone.

coding.rationale: Generating and updating recipe suggestions whenever groceries are added helps the resident use available food, avoiding meal-planning inconvenience.

responsibility_name: Support waking at the intended time

evidence.evidence_text: When the alarm rings, the back of the bed starts to rise at the preset speed.
If the backrest is raised and our user does not get up, then after five minutes the alarm rings and the backrest starts to vibrate.

coding.rationale: Raising the bed backrest at alarm time, with escalating vibration if the user does not get up, ensures waking by the intended time.

responsibility_name: detect and record nighttime garden intrusions when away

evidence.evidence_text: IF the time is between 23:00 and 07:00 AND the user is not at home WHEN there is movement in the garden, TURN ON the outside lights and SEND the security camera footage to the 'user.

coding.rationale: Turning on lights and sending camera footage for garden movement between 23:00-07:00 while away guards the property against nighttime intrusion.

responsibility_name: deter garden intrusions when occupants absent or sleeping

evidence.evidence_text: When movement is detected in the rear garden, the trigger signals the event by turning on the external lights and the alarm if the user distance is greater than or equal to 200m or the sensor on the bed has detected the weight .

coding.rationale: Activating external lights and alarm on rear-garden movement when the user is far away or in bed deters intrusions; context blends absence and sleeping.

responsibility_name: Ensure the cat can be located when it leaves detection range

evidence.evidence_text: When the video surveillance system does not detect the presence of the cat, the GPS collar of the same emits an audible alert and the user receives the position of the collar on the telephone.

coding.rationale: Triggering the GPS collar alert and reporting its position when the cat leaves camera range prevents losing track of the pet.
